origin.text: You awaken in a state of pure awareness. Before you lie three impulses.

meaning.text: You focus on purpose. A path of intention forms in your mind.

instinct.text: You follow raw impulse. Your senses sharpen.

question.text: You challenge every assumption. Possibilities multiply.

commitment.text: Your resolve solidifies. You feel complete.

doubt.text: Your thoughts fracture. You struggle to hold form.

momentum.text: Your instincts carry you to a decisive conclusion.

hesitation.text: Your momentum fades. You dissolve into indecision.

uncertainty.text: You embrace the unknown and become part of it.

clarity.text: Your mind sharpens. You transcend the trial.
